verdict.rationale: GitCafe's ruleset docs say rulesets protect matching branches or tags and can require pull requests, reviews and passing checks, as well as block deletion and force pushes. They also document a warning-only Evaluate mode and CODEOWNERS approvals. Checks come from Buildkite and GitHub Actions, so the required-checks gate has real check sources. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that ruleset enforcement works as documented.
